1.title: House Adopts $95 Billion G.O.P. Budget for Iran War
1.summary: Republican leaders muscled through resistance in their own ranks to approve the budget blueprint for the war and other measures, but its prospects were far dimmer in the Senate.

2.title: House Republicans Pass Stock Trading Bill Tied to SAVE Act and Voter ID Measure
2.summary: The measure has drawn bipartisan backing amid a public outcry against the practice, but Democrats opposed it after Republicans added a voter ID requirement.

3.title: U.S. Signs Deal to Help Saudis Obtain Nuclear Power
3.summary: The accord is intended to further bind the United States with the Saudi government as the war with Iran strains the relationship.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Iran Digs In After Latest Trump Threat on Civilian Targets
4.summary: President Trump said the United States would target a bridge or power plant if Iran fired on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s foreign minister repeated his nation’s position of an “eye for an eye.”

5.title: Israeli Banks Threaten to Cut Off Palestinian Economy
5.summary: Two Israeli financial firms have long served as partners to Palestinian banks, handling transactions that make possible the West Bank’s imports and exports.

6.title: US signs landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
6.summary: The US Department of Energy says the "peaceful" co-operation agreement will give US firms "great access" to the Saudi nuclear energy programme.
